open_item_bindings.effect_on_this_scenario: no value effect: design 14:429 states the position is closed immediately BEFORE the event timestamp, so it is ineligible under an INCLUDE rule as well as under an EXCLUDE rule. The INCLUDE answer creates a separate build obligation (a fill AT the exact funding timestamp) that this declared vector does not exercise; that obligation is recorded in the applicability draft and is not a CONTRACT_TABLES cell.

open_item_bindings.owner_disposition: CLOSED (5a) - the closed-lifecycle premise is built with ordinary price bars before the observation window, by the real mechanism, with nothing injected
open_item_bindings.effect_on_this_scenario: design v1.15 line 1105 left the LEGACY premise as [OPEN-EMBED-05] and design 15.6 blocked the runnable premise and its dependent cells. The owner answer makes the premise reachable: lifecycle 1 opens and closes on ordinary bars before 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, so at the window start no position is eligible for TEST-FUND-1. Because those fills are outside the observation window they contribute no in-window fill, cash, fee or exit facts. The pre-window fills DO consume the GREEN cost record (design v1.15 lines 490,1107); the pre-window fill prices/quantities are unenumerated, so the equity node carries BLOCKED-OPEN-EMBED-05 (design v1.15 lines 494,806,1107).
